title: Export a digest-bound CycloneDX SBOM as a release artefact in docker-publish.yml
description:
In applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server/.github/workflows/docker-publish.yml (job build-push):
(a) Add `id: build` to the 'Build and push image to dockerhub registry' step so its `digest` output can be referenced. Keep `sbom: true` and `provenance: mode=max` unchanged.
(b) After that step, add an SBOM step that runs syft 1.51.1 (the version pinned in .claude/skills/scanner-toolchain/references/toolchain.json). Use either anchore/sbom-action pinned by full commit SHA or a checksum-verified syft download. Point it at `${{ vars.DOCKERHUB_IMAGE_REPOSITORY }}@${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}` with output format cyclonedx-json, write `sbom.cdx.json`, and write the digest to `image-digest.txt`.
(c) Upload both files with actions/upload-artifact pinned by full commit SHA. Name the artefact `mcp-gateway-sbom-${{ steps.docker-tags.outputs.VERSION }}` and set a retention period long enough for capture (at least 90 days).
Constraints: job permissions stay `contents: read`; add no new secrets; the new steps run only after the push succeeds. Merge by PR with the 1 approval that sdlc/policy.json releaseProcess requires, and exercise it through the dev -> qa -> prod environment order. No deploymentWindows or changeFreeze apply.
acceptanceCriteria: `grep -n 'cyclonedx-json' .github/workflows/docker-publish.yml` in the mongodb-mcp-server checkout returns the new SBOM step, and `grep -n 'id: build' .github/workflows/docker-publish.yml` returns the build-push step id
Every `uses:` line added by the PR references a 40-character commit SHA, and the job `permissions` block is still only `contents: read`

The first publish.yml or docker.yml run after merge lists an artefact named mcp-gateway-sbom-<version> (`gh run view <run-id> --json artifacts`) containing sbom.cdx.json with `bomFormat` = CycloneDX and image-digest.txt equal to the digest pushed in that run's build log

verificationMethod.description: Review the merged PR diff of .github/workflows/docker-publish.yml. Expected: the build step has id build; the SBOM step targets the image by steps.build.outputs.digest with cyclonedx-json output; the upload step is SHA-pinned; permissions and secrets are unchanged. Then open the first release run and confirm the mcp-gateway-sbom-<version> artefact is present and that its sbom.cdx.json metadata.component version equals the pushed digest.

rootCause.description: The release workflow only attaches a buildx SBOM attestation to the registry image. No step exports that SBOM as a retrievable file bound to the image digest, so there is nothing to capture into the workspace inventory.
